BACnet Function Code and Service Choice Reference
=================================================

Scope
-----
This file contains standardized BACnet protocol operation identifiers:

1. BACnet APDU PDU Type
2. Confirmed Service Choice
3. Unconfirmed Service Choice
4. BACnet/IP BVLC Function
5. BACnet/IP BVLC Result Code
6. BACnet Network Layer Message Type
7. Reject Reason
8. Abort Reason
9. Error Class

The values marked RESERVED must not be interpreted as currently defined
standard operations.

================================================================
1. BACnet APDU PDU TYPE
================================================================

The APDU type is stored in the high nibble of the first APDU octet.

0x00 = Confirmed-Request-PDU
0x10 = Unconfirmed-Request-PDU
0x20 = SimpleACK-PDU
0x30 = ComplexACK-PDU
0x40 = SegmentACK-PDU
0x50 = Error-PDU
0x60 = Reject-PDU
0x70 = Abort-PDU

PDU type numeric value before shifting:

0 = Confirmed-Request-PDU
1 = Unconfirmed-Request-PDU
2 = SimpleACK-PDU
3 = ComplexACK-PDU
4 = SegmentACK-PDU
5 = Error-PDU
6 = Reject-PDU
7 = Abort-PDU

================================================================
2. BACnet CONFIRMED SERVICE CHOICE

  Description: Protocol field 'bacnet_application_data'. Layer: asdu. Role: payload. Type: variable. Inferred-from: wire. Binding-strength: tag_parse. Evidence-type: length_check.
  Length: variable
  Implementation constraints: Payload length must not exceed remaining APDU bytes, Encoded as a BACnet Application Tag (Tag Number + Length/Value Type) followed by the tag payload, Length of the tag payload is determined by bacnet_application_data_length(tag.number, tag.len_value_type)

- Field: bacnet_sc_primary_hub_uri
  Description: Protocol field 'bacnet_sc_primary_hub_uri'. Layer: asdu. Role: address. Type: string. Constraints: valid URI syntax, terminating NULL required, separator character ('|') splits URI from optional port number. Inferred-from: wire. Binding-strength: explicit_check. Evidence-type: tag_parse.
  Length: variable
  Implementation constraints: BACNET_CHARACTER_STRING internal capacity ≤ ~128 chars, no explicit UTF-8/ASCII tag in wire encoding, port suffix parsed in-place by sc_binding_parse(), exactly one URI string per ASDU, separator '|' must precede decimal port number
- Field: bacnet_sc_failover_hub_uri
  Description: Protocol field 'bacnet_sc_failover_hub_uri'. Layer: asdu. Role: address. Type: string. Constraints: max length imposed by BACnet character-string encoding (up to 255 bytes payload plus length octet), must be null-terminated when used in local stack storage. Inferred-from: wire. Binding-strength: direct_byte_parse. Evidence-type: tag_parse.
  Length: variable
  Implementation constraints: stack buffers sized to accomodate 255-byte string plus null terminator, parser stops at first null byte in local copy, BACnet character-string type requires first octet to hold length (max 255 octets), no padding required beyond length octet
